description:
## Approved plan task C3

- **Functional scope/files:** shared web structs/validators, WebBridge and Channels request-context propagation. Add widget context, configuration scope, C1-approved prompt context and the section 4.6 event set. Implement a fixture adapter in tests against the real public ingress.
- **Behavior:** same Message/Command as BO; Engine-authorized identity/routing; bridge-managed mapping to adapter-supplied topics/events; safe public payload projection; typing/start/edit/step/complete/failure lifecycle. Optional visible steps carry summaries, not raw reasoning/private traces.
- **Execution ownership:** use one explicit owner for acceptance and terminal delivery; derive stable message IDs before the first update. Test normal pipeline delivery and pre-delivery fallback together. If request-local serialization/state is required, keep it in a bounded Channels transport owner with cleanup on success/failure/timeout, not in Engine or a permanent conversation store; specify its multi-node routing before implementation.
- **Tests before implementation:** identical shared message inputs for BO/widget; snapshot vs append streaming; create-before-update and terminal ordering; no double terminal on sync responses/fallback; errors before/after acceptance; isolation across two widgets/two conversations; malformed event mapping; allowed metadata projection; no privilege/topic override; reconnect/history recovery.
- **Branches:** async acceptance and events, C1-approved sync terminal return, sync init/history, no-stream final response, stream failure, missing subscriber, disabled config and inaccessible conversation.
- **Mocking:** actual PubSub/Engine/Repo; test adapter is an external-adapter fixture, not an internal production stub. External LLM deterministic.
- **Documentation:** versioned schema/event mapping and sync/async/delivery semantics; record no durable exactly-once or automatic uncertain-retry guarantee.
- **Action reuse:** reuse C2 operations and existing routing/pipeline/status/final delivery. Event encoding is local-only transport logic; no generic tool or workflow action is needed for serialization.
- **Done:** external developer can exercise the complete ZAQ message/init/history contract using the conformance fixture without a widget UI.

## Execution requirements
Branch: refactor/webbridge. Source: GitHub www-zaq-ai/zaq#830. Read AGENTS.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, and applicable service guides before implementation. Shared contracts, module responsibilities, reuse evidence, decisions and regression obligations are in parent zaq-pkd. Write the specified immediate tests first; use real internal boundaries and mock only external edges. Preserve canonical-history authorization, config-scoped delivery and Engine admission/finalization. New/substantially rewritten feature E2E must wait for B3 human approval. Inbound message.edit is excluded; outbound streaming edits remain included.
title: [830] C3 — Extend shared contracts and delivery mapping for widget conformance
